fields.label: Zalo User ID
fields.description: The user's Zalo ID inside THIS Mini App (different from the same person's ID in the vehicle Mini App). Created automatically when the user opens the app; HR may also create the account by hand from the ID the app shows.

fields.label: Phone
fields.description: Phone used to find the employee (last 9 digits matched against Employee Cell Number). HR sets it by hand when Zalo could not provide the number (simulator, user refused the permission); it is overwritten whenever the user signs in with Zalo's phone permission. Changing it ends every open session of this account.

fields.label: Phone Source
fields.description: Zalo = confirmed by Zalo at sign-in · Manual = set by HR

fields.label: Last Login Result
fields.options:
ACTIVE
READ_ONLY
NOT_FOUND
NO_PHONE
EXPIRED
DISABLED

fields.label: Disabled
fields.description: Blocks login and revokes open sessions on the next request. Ticked automatically for a new account whose phone does not match an employee who may use the portal (see Disabled Automatically).

The system disabled this account at creation: its phone did not match an employee who may use the portal (Active, or Left within Read-only Days After Leaving). Cleared together with Disabled as soon as that changes (HR sets a matching phone, Zalo confirms one at sign-in, the person rejoins). An account HR disables by hand is never re-enabled automatically.
fields.label: Disabled Automatically
Allow Dev Login
fields.description: Lets this account sign in with dev_login (Zalo simulator, NOT verified with Zalo). Only works while site_config has employee_portal_dev_login = 1. Tick only for the test team.
